name: rollenspiel-ai
description: Location-based AI storytelling platform with 4 variants

scripts.dev: echo 'Choose a variant: npm run dev:medieval, dev:gamer, dev:museum, or dev:explorer'
scripts.build: npm run build:medieval && npm run build:gamer && npm run build:museum && npm run build:explorer
scripts.build:medieval: cd variant-a-medieval && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:gamer: cd variant-b-gamer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:museum: cd variant-c-museum && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:explorer: cd variant-d-explorer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd variant-a-medieval && npm install && cd ../variant-b-gamer && npm install && cd ../variant-c-museum && npm install && cd ../variant-d-explorer && npm install

author: rollenspiel.ai
